articles.summary: We’ve created the complete guide on how to become a political campaign manager, with a rundown on all the skills you need to have, where you can complete a professional certificate or training program,, and how much you can expect to make.

articles.summary: This is a very personal question, and it's important to consider all of the factors involved. If you're running for local office, you'll need to hire staff to run your campaign. And hiring friends or family can be an incredible way to build your team.
articles.title: Should I Hire Friends or Family For My Political Campaign?
